# Show us your worst agent PR

AgentProof gets better when it learns from real review pain.

Share a sanitized example of an AI-generated PR that looked confident but was not safe to merge.

Useful details:

- What did the agent claim?
- What was actually wrong?
- Which signal would have caught it earlier?
- Should this become a new AgentProof rule?

Please remove secrets, private customer data, and proprietary code before posting.
